events.summary: An angel rose above Varrik the Bloody, who died as Varrik the Just was born.
events.quote: She rose above me, and in that moment Varrik the Bloody died and I was born.

events.summary: Rayel Vanger calls on soldiers to face certain death.
events.quote: Who among you has the courage to face certain death?

events.summary: The wind lifted Idrus to his feet and he fought on.
events.quote: but it lifted me to my feet and I fought on.

events.summary: Grakk felt warm and fuzzy inside for the first time.
events.quote: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

events.summary: Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar and turned his ambitions skyward.
events.quote: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward

events.summary: Jace mocks Garruk Wildspeaker's slow grasp of a spell.
events.quote: since you've only recently begun to walk upright, it may take some time to explain.

events.summary: Jace found interesting ideas to improve upon in the memories of the Iquati.
events.quote: Jace found interesting ideas to improve upon.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas threatens an opponent and mocks a planeswalker's defeat.
events.quote: Where is your arrogant pride now?

events.summary: Liliana Vess takes a mind's secrets.
A planeswalker explains that planeswalking cannot be taught.
Koth melts what was not darksteel.
events.quote: Looks like that wasn't darksteel after all.

events.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker declares nature will remain when cities crumble.
events.quote: When your cities and trinkets crumble, only nature will remain.
'Utterly' is my favorite way to destroy something.

events.summary: Krenko urges his goblins to bring death to enemies.
events.quote: We'll bring death, shiny sharp, to our enemies.
